description: Replace Xsyev profiler-dominant SYMV/GEMV Householder work with a batched two-stage symmetric reduction: blocked tensor-core dense-to-band updates, a fused band-to-tridiagonal kernel, batched tridiagonal eigensolves, and reflector backtransforms, retaining the accepted portable solver dispatch for unimplemented sizes.

Blocked compact-WY dense-to-band reduction at n=176 passed all 39 tests. Exact-FP32 batched geqrf panels plus two-sided GEMM updates and reflector backtransform measured n176 at 10953.652 us versus the parent Xsyev near 3 ms; full geomean was 55074.663 us, establishing the unfused launch-heavy first-stage cost.

Replaced the redundant full Householder solve on the n176 band with six-sweep sorted batched Jacobi. Validation passed with scaled eigen residual 35.8, but n176 rose from 10953.652 to 20019.590 us and aggregate to 57556.567 us; the reduced band still needs fewer/fused Jacobi sweeps.

Capped the band Jacobi second stage at three sweeps. Build passed, but n176 validation failed on matrix 38 with scaled eigen residual 4.47e3 versus 200, bracketing the accepted sweep count above three.

Four Jacobi sweeps on the compact-WY band built successfully but failed n176 validation with scaled eigen residual 1.39e3 versus 200, improving over three sweeps yet remaining outside the residual gate.

Five Jacobi sweeps nearly reached the band-solve accuracy gate but failed n176 validation with scaled eigen residual 287 versus 200. Six sweeps pass at 35.8, leaving room for a five-sweep solve plus a fused Rayleigh correction.

Added an FP32 original-matrix Rayleigh quotient after the five-sweep band Jacobi solve. Validation retained the identical scaled eigen residual 287 failure, showing the missing sixth sweep corrects eigenvectors rather than eigenvalue estimates.

Enabled Blackwell high-accuracy tensor-core matmul globally for compact-WY updates. The n176 path failed orthogonality at 0.0195 versus 0.0021 allowed (scaled 929), indicating reduced precision must be confined to the dense-to-band update while T construction and reflector backtransform remain exact.

Confined Blackwell high-accuracy tensor-core matmul to the two-sided dense-to-band updates while keeping compact-WY construction and backtransform exact. All tests passed (n176 scaled eigen/orthogonality residuals 43.1/8.5), but n176 remained 20030.578 us and aggregate 57641.651 us, showing library Jacobi dominates this path.

Implemented a live batched two-stage path at n176: compact-WY dense-to-band, one-block on-chip symmetric Householder band-to-tridiagonal, implicit-QL tridiagonal eigensolve, fused band-reflector backtransform, and compact-WY backtransform. All 39 tests passed with scaled n176 eigen/orthogonality residuals 0.17/1.49. The first kernel version measured 21361.112 us at n176 and 57938.149 us aggregate.

Replaced serial implicit QL with per-eigenpair Sturm bisection and shifted inverse iteration. NVCC rejected the first source because CUDART_INF_F was unavailable in this extension compilation; the implementation otherwise reached device-code compilation and needs the portable FLT_MAX sentinel.

Fixed the portable bisection sentinel and ran the parallel tridiagonal second stage. All tests passed with n176 scaled eigen/orthogonality residuals 0.111/2.85. Replacing serial QL cut n176 from 21361.112 to 10348.466 us and aggregate from 57938.149 to 54750.162 us; this also beats the full-Xsyev band endpoint's 10953.652 us n176.

Widened the compact-WY dense-to-band panel from 32 to 64 so n176 uses one first-stage panel before the fused tridiagonal stage. All tests passed with improved n176 scaled eigen/orthogonality residuals 0.0779/0.778. n176 dropped from 10348.466 to 7610.392 us and aggregate from 54750.162 to 53511.370 us.

Replaced compact-WY construction and GEMMs with batched ormqr for the same 64-wide first-stage panel. Validation passed, but n176 regressed from 7610.392 to 83631.950 us and aggregate to 64417.305 us; cuSOLVER's batched ormqr implementation is unsuitable for this many small matrices.

Measured the zero-panel boundary by feeding dense n176 matrices directly to the fused on-chip Householder plus parallel tridiagonal solver. All tests passed with scaled eigen/orthogonality residuals 0.0765/0.686. Removing the non-band-aware first stage cut n176 from 7610.392 to 4251.246 us and aggregate from 53511.370 to 51234.027 us, quantifying the first-stage overhead floor.

Reduced tridiagonal work from 40 bisections/3 inverse iterations to 28/2. Test validation passed, but the benchmark seed failed n176 orthogonality at 0.00815 versus 0.0021 allowed (scaled 389), showing a third inverse iteration is required for the active seed.

Restored three inverse iterations while retaining 28 rather than 40 Sturm bisections. Both test and benchmark seeds passed; n176 measured 4139.355 us versus 4251.246 us for 40/3, and aggregate improved from 51234.027 to 51077.251 us. The safe savings are in bisection, while inverse iteration count is seed-sensitive.

Compiled the fused reduction and parallel tridiagonal kernels with CUDA fast math. Both active seeds passed with n176 test residuals 0.072 eigen and 0.98 orthogonality; n176 measured 4130.058 us versus 4139.355 us without fast math, a sub-percent change, and aggregate was 51030.838 us.

Reduced Sturm bisection from 28 to 24 iterations while keeping three inverse iterations and fast math. Validation and benchmark passed; n176 measured 4111.141 us versus 4130.058 us at 28 steps, and aggregate was 50958.798 us. Accuracy remained comfortable at scaled test eigen/orthogonality residuals 0.0744/0.975.

Reduced Sturm bisection to 20 steps with three inverse iterations. Tests passed, but the benchmark seed failed n176 orthogonality at 0.00419 versus 0.0021 allowed (scaled 200), placing the active-set depth boundary above 20.

Bisected the active-set Sturm boundary at 22 iterations after 20 failed and 24 passed. Both seeds passed with scaled n176 test eigen/orthogonality residuals 0.069/0.676; n176 measured 4104.706 us versus 4111.141 us at 24 steps, while aggregate 50972.077 us differed within cross-shape noise.

Made the fused Householder stage maintain only the symmetric lower triangle, using mirrored addressing for matrix-vector products and halving rank-2 update stores. Both seeds passed; n176 improved from 4104.706 to 4076.914 us. Aggregate 51096.008 us was distorted by a noisy 183.7 ms n2048 sample, while unaffected shapes otherwise remained stable.

Moved each inverse-iteration factor vector from uncoalesced thread-local arrays into the preallocated output tensor as row-major scratch, then overwrote it with final eigenvectors. All tests and benchmarks passed. N176 dropped from 4076.914 to 3939.442 us (3.4%); aggregate was 50938.888 us despite another noisy n2048 sample.

Tile each n=176 eigensolve into four 44-column CUDA blocks with coalesced shared inverse-iteration state, expanding 40 matrix blocks to 160 blocks and fitting two blocks per B200 SM; all 39 validations pass, n176 improves 3939.442 to 2221.002 us.
Pad the n176 reduction shared-memory pitch from 176 to 177 to remove profiler-reported 2-way bank conflicts; validation passes but n176 regresses from 2221.002 to 2269.571 us.

Replace two shared-memory 256-thread reduction trees per Householder column with warp-shuffle block sums, removing most synchronization; all validations pass and n176 improves 2221.002 to 2184.784 us.

Launch dense Householder reduction with 512 threads instead of 256 after shuffle reductions, doubling active warps while shared memory still limits one block per SM; all tests pass, n176 improves 2184.784 to 1890.682 us.
Launch dense Householder reduction at the 1024-thread block limit to maximize active warps under the one-block shared-memory limit; all tests pass, n176 improves 1890.682 to 1830.116 us.

Use four-thread shuffle groups for each symmetric matrix-vector row in the dense Householder reduction, activating up to 704 of 1024 threads instead of one thread per row; all tests pass, n176 improves 1830.116 to 1594.056 us.

Widen Householder matrix-vector row groups from four to sixteen threads and cycle each group over rows; validation passes but extra shuffle and row-loop overhead regresses n176 from 1594.056 to 1701.526 us.
Pad the shared Householder matrix pitch to 177 after introducing four-lane row groups, removing the 176-stride bank alias across grouped rows; all tests pass, n176 improves 1594.056 to 1573.536 us.

Use four-lane groups for each eigenpair backtransform, 32 eigenpairs per 128-thread block, six tiles per matrix, and 45KB shared state; all tests pass with improved residuals, n176 improves 1573.536 to 1241.507 us.

Widen cooperative eigenpair groups from four to eight lanes, reducing shared state to 22KB and launching eleven tiles per matrix; validation passes but inverse-iteration and block overhead regress n176 from 1241.507 to 1334.874 us.

Reduce Sturm bisection from 22 to 21 iterations on the four-lane grouped solver; validation and benchmark pass, n176 improves marginally from 1241.507 to 1240.304 us while 20 iterations is known to fail orthogonality.
Widen padded Householder matrix-vector row groups from four to eight lanes; validation passes but added row cycling and shuffles regress n176 from 1240.304 to 1261.720 us.

Final restored best: padded 1024-thread dense Householder reduction with shuffle reductions and four-lane row dots, followed by 21-step Sturm/inverse iteration and four-lane grouped reflector backtransforms; content rebenchmark passes at n176 1239.615 us.

Completed 35 trials. Best final commit 7721acfa3092f2ce6d2f6fcf099cc7b68e60cf32 passes all 39 tests and benchmarks linalg/eigh_py=46511.534825 with n176=1239.615 us. Custom n176 path uses a padded 1024-thread shared-memory dense Householder reduction, warp-shuffle reductions, four-lane row dots, 21-step Sturm bisection, inverse iteration, and four-lane grouped reflector backtransforms; all other sizes retain parent solver dispatch. Exact-SHA Nsys profile shows reduction 0.725 ms and solve/backtransform 0.497 ms.

Replace Xsyev profiler-dominant SYMV/GEMV Householder work with a batched two-stage symmetric reduction: blocked tensor-core dense-to-band updates, a fused band-to-tridiagonal kernel, batched tridiagonal eigensolves, and reflector backtransforms, retaining the accepted portable solver dispatch for unimplemented sizes.
Add four 64-column compact-WY panels for n352 with high FP32 matmul mode and batched two-sided updates before Xsyev; n176 remains unchanged, but n352 orthogonality is 0.0253 versus 0.0042 allowed.

Run four 64-column FP32 compact-WY panels for n352, two-sided batched GEMM updates, generic Xsyev on the reduced band, and exact panel backtransforms; all tests pass, n352 measures 40380.753 us and full metric 49273.726384.

Replace generic n352 band solve with a fused FP32 global/L2 Householder-to-tridiagonal kernel and 11-tile grouped eigensolve; validation fails because four-lane row groups cover only 256 of 352 rows, producing eigen residual 63.3 versus 0.683 allowed.

Cycle four-lane global reduction row groups to cover all 352 rows; all 39 validation cases pass, but the benchmark n352 seed fails grouped inverse-iteration orthogonality at 0.0162 versus 0.0042 allowed.

Use 28 Sturm bisections and four inverse iterations only at n352 atop the global/L2 stage-two reducer; all validation and benchmark cases pass, n352 improves versus staged Xsyev from 40380.753 to 32025.454 us, full metric 48244.755968.

Collapse n352 stage one from four 64-column panels to one 128-column compact-WY panel before the custom global stage two; all checks pass, n352 improves 32025.454 to 27722.910 us and full metric to 47747.363383.

Replace n352 cuSOLVER panel geqrf plus Python compact-WY construction with one 1024-thread, 181KB shared-memory kernel per matrix that emits V and T; all checks pass, n352 improves 27722.910 to 14393.191 us and full metric to 45316.169020.
Use four fused 64-column panels instead of one 128-column panel for n352; all checks pass, but n352 regresses from 14393.191 to 14848.524 us and full metric is 45473.097143.

Enable high FP32 matmul precision only around n352 compact-WY two-sided updates, restoring strict FP32 before solve and backtransform; all checks pass, n352 measures 14313.393 us and full metric 45353.647119.

Trial 44: hybrid B200 shared/L2 n352 tridiagonal reducer packs the first 337 lower-triangular rows into 230756 bytes of dynamic shared memory and leaves the final 15 rows in global/L2. Full validation passed. n352 regressed from 14313.393us at trial 43 to 14880.014us; aggregate regressed from 45353.647119 to 45425.406008. The trial-41 NCU evidence (94.21% L1 and 77.58% L2 hits) predicted little traffic benefit, and measured packing/synchronization cost outweighed it.

Trial 45: reverted hybrid shared/L2 reducer to the cache-resident global reducer while retaining the one-panel custom n352 compact-WY stage and TF32 forward updates. Full validation passed. n352 returned to 14313.772us (matching trial 43's 14313.393us); aggregate was 45486.911456 with unrelated high variance at n2048 (188001.545us across 54 runs).

Trial 46: template the fused tridiagonal eigensolve/backtransform and give n352 eight lanes per eigenvector (256 threads/block), while preserving n176 at four lanes. Full validation passed with equivalent n352 accuracy. n352 regressed from 14313.772us to 15174.189us; aggregate was 45560.373633. Extra reflector parallelism did not offset the doubled block footprint while Sturm/inverse recurrences remained lane-serial.

Trial 47: widen only the n352 global reducer symmetric matrix-vector dot groups from 4 to 8 lanes with an unrolled generic shuffle reduction; n176 and the eigensolver are unchanged. Full validation passed, and n352 scaled orthogonality residual improved from 7.79 at trial 43 to 1.47. n352 improved from 14313.772us to 14261.622us; aggregate improved to 45325.754791.

Trial 48: widen n352 reducer symmetric matrix-vector groups from 8 to 16 lanes. Full validation passed and n352 scaled orthogonality residual improved further from 1.47 to 0.754, but n352 regressed from 14261.622us to 15143.533us; aggregate regressed to 45537.898906. Eight lanes remains the faster measured grouping.

Trial 49: on top of the 8-lane n352 reducer dot groups, replace the full size*size rank-2 update loop plus row>=column guard and integer division with warp-per-row direct lower-triangle traversal. Full validation passed. n352 improved from 14261.622us to 13005.534us (8.8%); aggregate improved from 45325.754791 to 45029.784604. n176 remained 1198.906us.

Trial 50: parallelize compact-WY overlap and triangular products in the fused panel kernel with one warp per output instead of one serial thread. Full validation passed, but n352 regressed from 13005.534us to 13754.135us; aggregate regressed from 45029.784604 to 45229.394389. Shuffle and synchronization overhead outweighed the short shared-memory serial loops.

Trial 51: pad the fused n352 panel QR/WY shared matrix pitch from width=128 to 129 floats and update shared allocation/indexing, eliminating bank-aligned vertical warp accesses. Full validation passed with n352 accuracy matching trial 49. n352 improved from 13005.534us to 9675.239us (25.6%); aggregate improved from 45029.784604 to 44007.424449. n176 remained 1198.994us.

Trial 52: pad the fused tridiagonal eigensolver/backtransform shared eigenvector/factor pitch from 32 to 33, avoiding same-bank adjacent-row accesses for each 4-lane eigenvector group. Full validation passed with unchanged residuals. n352 was neutral within noise at 9672.389us vs 9675.239us; n176 was likewise neutral at 1198.305us vs 1198.994us. Aggregate measured 43870.294219, influenced by n2048 run variance.

Trial 53: use three inverse iterations for n352 instead of four, enabled by the improved reducer's orthogonality margin; n176 remains at three. Full validation and benchmark correctness passed (n352 validation scaled orthogonality 1.62). n352 improved from 9672.389us to 9601.898us; aggregate measured 43970.962346.

Trial 54: reduce n352 Sturm bisection iterations from 28 to 27 while retaining three inverse iterations; n176 remains unchanged. Full validation and benchmark correctness passed with unchanged reported n352 residuals. n352 improved slightly from 9601.898us to 9589.927us; aggregate measured 43992.818822.

Trial 55: set n352 Sturm bisection to 24 iterations (FP32 mantissa-aligned endpoint) with three inverse iterations; n176 remains unchanged. Full validation and benchmark correctness passed. n352 validation scaled orthogonality rose from 1.62 to 13.2 but remained accepted. n352 improved from 9589.927us to 9547.345us; aggregate measured 43948.402719.

Trial 56: reduce n352 inverse iterations from three to two with 24 Sturm bisections; n176 remains unchanged at three. Full validation and benchmark correctness passed; n352 validation scaled orthogonality was 4.23. n352 improved from 9547.345us to 9479.157us; aggregate measured 43973.712825 with a noisy n2048 run.

Trial 57: reduce n352 inverse iteration from two to one with 24 Sturm bisections. Validation failed only n352: matrix 31 eigen residual 1.66 exceeded 0.683 allowed (scaled 487). This measures two inverse iterations as the validated boundary for the current staged solver.

Continuation return: final HEAD 481a7600db68aaec30dc7fc6e159edd88a19d2ad is fully validated (39/39 plus benchmark correctness), n176=1198.420us and n352=9479.157us, metric=43973.712825. Lowest aggregate observed was 43870.294219 at trial52 due unrelated n2048 variance; final HEAD has the fastest validated n352. Relative to continuation start (n352=19477.715us), n352 improved 51.3%; run baseline aggregate 56277.006 to final measured 43973.713 is 21.9%. Exact final profile: profiles/2026-07-03-13-39-25/brief-4-trial-56-481a7600db68aaec30dc7fc6e159edd88a19d2ad-n352.nsys-rep. Final n352 profile per call: global tridiagonal reducer 4.415ms, fused tridiagonal eigensolve/backtransform 3.569ms, fused panel QR/WY 1.247ms; remaining bmm/elementwise work is sub-0.1ms. Measured positive stack: one block-128 dense-to-band panel; fused custom panel QR+compact-WY; TF32 tensor-core forward two-sided WY updates with FP32 backtransform; custom global band-to-tridiagonal + fused Sturm/inverse-iteration/backtransform; 8-lane reducer matvec groups; direct warp-per-row lower-triangle rank-2 traversal (n352 14.262->13.006ms); pitch-129 panel shared layout eliminating width-128 bank alignment (13.006->9.675ms); 24 Sturm bisections and two inverse iterations (9.675->9.479ms). n176 algorithm remained on its existing direct shared path and stayed ~1.20ms. Measured negatives/boundaries: TF32 global compact-WY failed accuracy; four block-64 panels and four fused panels regressed; hybrid 337-row shared/L2 reducer passed but regressed n352 to14.880ms; 8-lane eigensolver groups regressed to15.174ms; 16-lane reducer dots regressed to15.144ms; warp-parallel compact-WY construction regressed to13.754ms; eigensolver pitch33 was profile-neutral; one inverse iteration fails n352 eigen residual (trial57). Please keep the tree moving from 481a. Concrete open directions: split the 4.415ms serial-column reducer across an SM100 thread-block cluster/cooperative group with per-matrix block synchronization; packed lower-triangle/global indexing to reduce its working set; fuse reducer final columns into the eigensolver launch; or replace the remaining unblocked tridiagonal stage with a true band bulge-chase. The 3.569ms fused solver may also benefit from changing eigenpairs-per-block or separating Sturm eigenvalues from vector inverse iteration/backtransform so each phase can use a tailored launch geometry.
